$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA eAIP AD 2 LFSI (AIP France, valid from 2026-08-06).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Saint-Dizier-Robinson is a military air base (Armee de l'Air et de l'Espace). Its tower and approach follow the
CAM regimes (circulation aerienne militaire): CAM V (Victor, a vue) and CAM I (India, aux instruments).
MSFS exposes only VHF radios: the UHF frequencies of the base (243.000, 342.000, 362.300, 388.800) are not usable.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Saint-Dizier-Robinson

service.controlZone: CTR Saint-Dizier, class D, SFC to FL 055, possible activation H24, CAM/CAG procedures. LF-P 72 Saint-Dizier: entry prohibited.

circuit.handNote: ASSUMPTION, not read from a published text: circuit south of the runways, right-hand for QFU 11 and left-hand for QFU 29. Check against the base's own procedures.

notes: Military base: civil VFR pilots do not fly in without prior agreement; in the simulator the flight is flown in CAM V or CAM I.
The base publishes its frequencies in UHF and VHF. Only the VHF ones are given here (APP 134.775 and 142.450, TWR 122.100 and 140.175 for line-up and take-off, PAR 123.300, SRE 140.900).
Arresting gear (BAR) marked by six yellow circles 3 m in diameter on the runway; BATR over 1200 m, east part, on runway 11L/29R used by the ACB.
Deactivation of the CTR is announced on 134.775 (RAI).
